title: Not Eligible | EU 261 (EU Mainland) | No Travel Incomplete | MSL Delay Below 3 Hours | Cancellation | Single Pax | 2 Legs
description:
EU Mainland multi-leg journey (CDG?YYZ?YVR). Leg 1 completed on time. Leg 2 (YYZ?YVR) cancelled due to controllable reason (cancellation code CREW). Customer stranded at YYZ � did not return to CDG, did not reach YVR. Re-routing delay was only 2 hours � below the 3-hour EU 261 threshold (Gate 8). Completes the EU No Travel Below Threshold matrix (Origin TC_105 + Return TC_106 + Incomplete TC_107). Validates: (1) Threshold check universally applied regardless of No Travel status type, (2) Controllable cancellation + below threshold = NE.

Prerequisites:
PNR: single passenger Damien Leroy (Adult). Journey: 2 legs AC operated: Leg 1 AC 871 CDG?YYZ (on time); Leg 2 AC 121 YYZ?YVR (CANCELLED). Cancellation code on Leg 2: CREW (Crew unavailability � Controllable). Re-routing delay: 2hrs (below 3hr threshold). Customer action: Stranded at YYZ (midpoint). Did NOT return to CDG. Did NOT reach YVR. No Travel status: Incomplete. Fallback: FALSE. MSL: Leg 2 (YYZ?YVR). Regime: EU 261 (EU Mainland � CDG origin). Result: NOT ELIGIBLE (delay below 3hr threshold).
